description: Source code for the MiniMaxHandler class, which integrates with the Anthropic API for prompt handling, message streaming, and cost calculation, including conversion of OpenAI tool choices to Anthropic format.

classes.name: MiniMaxHandler
classes.description: A class that handles communication with the MiniMax API, converting OpenAI tool choices, managing message streams, and calculating costs.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolChoice
methods.description: Converts OpenAI tool_choice parameter to Anthropic format.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream with the MiniMax API, handling different content block types and usage tracking.

methods.name: addCacheControl
methods.description: Adds cache control to the last two user messages for prompt caching.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model configuration and parameters.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt synchronously using the MiniMax API.
